text.tspan: In this lesson, you’ll learn how to order food naturally in Vietnam.
A warm bowl of phở is just a few words away.

g.text: Play the sentence, then choose its meaning.
I would like a bowl of pho.
What would you like to order?
I would like a bowl of pho.
What would you like to drink?
Please give me a glass of water.
Choose the word that makes this sentence feel complete.
Look what you can say now.

text.tspan: You’ve learned to order a meal, ask for a drink, and say thank you.

g.text: Why coffee is important in Vietnam

text.tspan: Coffee is not only something to drink. It is a place to sit, talk,
watch the street and give the day a little more time.

g.text: Cho tôi một cà phê sữa đá.
Please give me an iced coffee with condensed milk.
Take your time. Vietnamese coffee is often a social pause.
